evidence.eventual_fix_title: fix: fix AxiosHeaders conversion to an object during config merging
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix: fix AxiosHeaders conversion to an object during config merging

Hello everyone!

According to README.md, using `AxiosHeaders` is the recommended way to configure a request.
However, the current implementation of [`headersToObject`](https://github.com/axios/axios/blob/d844227411263fab39d447442879112f8b0c8de5/lib/core/mergeConfig.js#L6) function doesn't allow you to use an `AxiosHeaders` instance if you have "Content-Type" set in your default config.

[`headersToObject`](https://github.com/axios/axios/blob/d844227411263fab39d447442879112f8b0c8de5/lib/core/mergeConfig.js#L6) uses [`AxiosHeaders.prototype.toJSON`](https://github.com/axios/axios/blob/d844227411263fab39d447442879112f8b0c8de5/lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js#L226), which removes all `false` and `null` values. As a result, you can't override "Content-Type" with these values, even though they are valid [`AxiosHeaderValue`](https://github.com/axios/axios/blob/d844227411263fab39d447442879112f8b0c8de5/index.d.ts#L2). Also, that causes an [issue](https://github.com/axios/axios/issues/6240#issue-2141049539).

Replacing `AxiosHeaders.prototype.toJSON` with `{...thing}` can solve both of these problems.

closes #6240
